unsupported: The business began as a one-man shop focused on custom woodworking and has since grown into a dedicated studio producing handcrafted furniture and cabinetry.
The company specializes in custom kitchen cabinets, built-in furniture, and closet systems, all fabricated in its Belmont workshop.
Using traditional joinery techniques and hand-applied finishes, the team works with a variety of domestic and exotic hardwoods sourced globally.
Projects range from single pieces of furniture to full kitchen installations, with each item built to order.
Carolina Wood Designs serves primarily residential clients, including homeowners, interior designers, and builders seeking tailored woodwork for kitchens, living spaces, and storage solutions.
The portfolio includes custom dining tables, entertainment centers, and organizational closet systems, with examples displayed in the company's online gallery.
